phase: Phase F1c - real LRO two-way S-band Doppler against the LOLA precision orbit (no estimation)
written: 2026-10-24, before any F1c residual; the only Doppler inspection so far: the first 12 count differences of PAD 103 on 2009-260 (5 s spacing, ~2.62e8 counts/s, i.e. a ~22 kHz Doppler) and the transmit-frequency field (2091.414 MHz, reader fixed in 8187d44)
data: F1's 2009-260 files, PAD 103 / 105 / 126, records with the Doppler-validity flag
observable: average two-way range rate over each interval between consecutive valid records of one station (spacing 0 < dT <= 60 s, same pass): R' = -c * (dN/dT - 2.4e8) / (2 f_t K M), K = 240/221, M = 1000, f_t from the record at the interval start (453-HDBK-GN 4.3 / lro_desc_trk.txt), tagged at the counter-reading (receive) epochs
model: relativistic_light_time.counted_doppler at the interval midpoint with count interval dT, F1's M_FULL (DSN_C2 light time, DE440, high-precision Earth PCK, solid tide, media with the phase delay; uplink = the record's f_t, downlink = f_t * 240/221), LOLA SPK history as in F1

gates.R1_decode: every interval has dN > 0 and constant f_t within a pass
gates.R2_sign_scale: the residual RMS is below 1 % of the observed range-rate RMS on every pass (a wrong sign or scale would leave ~100 %)

hypotheses_reported_not_gated.H2: per-pass mean residual <= 5 mm/s (no frequency offset)
hypotheses_reported_not_gated.H3: the media phase delay reduces low-elevation residual trends (variant NO_MEDIA)
